endgameRuleGuide: Phase 2: must follow suit (win the trick if you can), else trump. Cards with a green ring are legal to play.
title: Schnapsen / Sixty-Six
subtitle: Austrian 2-player trick-taking — 20-card deck, marriages, first to 66

actions.marriageAria: Declare marriage: K + Q of {{suit}} for {{points}} points

tutorial.trump: The trump upcard and stock. The trump suit beats all others in a trick. When the stock runs out, phase 2 begins.
tutorial.trick: The current trick. In phase 2 you must follow suit (or trump if you can't).
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Click a card to play it. With a K+Q of the same suit you can declare a marriage (40 pts trump / 20 pts otherwise).
tutorial.actions: Advance or reset the game here. The first player to reach 66 points wins the round.

message.trickComplete: Trick complete — proceed to the next trick
